back_translation: Listen to me, O islands; pay attention, O distant peoples: The LORD called me from the womb; from my mother's body He spoke my name.
He made my mouth like a sharp sword; He hid me in the shadow of His hand. He made me a polished arrow and concealed me in His quiver.
He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will display My glory."
But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength on emptiness and futility. Yet the justice due me is with the LORD, and my reward is with my God."
And now the LORD says — He who formed me from the womb to be His servant, to bring Jacob back to Him and gather Israel to Him, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD, and my God is my strength —

He says: "It is too small a thing for you to be My servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have preserved. I will also appoint you as a light for the nations, that you may carry My salvation to the ends of the earth."

Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to the one despised and scorned, abhorred by the nation, the slave of rulers: "Kings will see you and stand up; princes will bow down, because of the LORD who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel who has chosen you."

Thus says the LORD: "In the time of favor I answered you, and in the day of salvation I helped you. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and reassign the desolate inheritances,
to say to the prisoners, 'Come out,' and to those in darkness, 'Show yourselves.' They will graze along the paths and find pasture on every bare hill.
They will not hunger or thirst; the scorching heat and the sun will not strike them. For He who has compassion on them will lead them and guide them to springs of water.
I will turn all My mountains into roads, and My highways will be raised up.
Behold, these will come from afar; behold, these from the north and the west, and these from the land of Sinim."
Shout for joy, O heavens! Rejoice, O earth! Break into song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people and will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me."
"Can a woman forget the infant still nursing at her breast? Can she lack compassion for the child of her womb? Even if these could forget, I will never forget you.
Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of My hands; your walls are always before Me.
Your children hasten back, and your destroyers and those who laid you waste will depart from you.
Lift up your eyes and look around: they all gather and come to you." The LORD declares: "As surely as I live, you will wear them all like jewelry and bind them on like a bride.
For your ruins and desolate places and your devastated land will now be too small for the inhabitants, and those who devoured you will be far away.
The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, 'This place is too small for us; make room for us to live.'
Then you will muse in your heart, 'Who bore these for me? I was bereaved and barren, exiled and rejected. Who raised these? Behold, I was left all alone — so where have these come from?'"

Thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, I will lift My hand to the nations and raise My signal banner to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters will be carried on their shoulders.

Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who wait for Me will not be put to shame."
Can the prey be snatched from the mighty warrior, or captives be rescued from a tyrant?

But thus says the LORD: "Even the captives of the mighty warrior will be taken away, and the prey of the tyrant will be rescued. For I will contend with those who contend with you, and I Myself will save your children.

I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they will be drunk on their own blood as with new wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."
